svg.title: Private resilience lab architecture
svg.desc: Logical network topology. Container Apps is VNet integrated and zone redundant. PostgreSQL uses Private Link with a primary and standby in distinct zones. Azure controls replica placement. Lifecycle workers remain active during suspension. Native editable vector shapes and text. Official Azure icons are embedded vector artwork from the Microsoft Azure icon library. Design source: docs/specification.md and DECISIONS-ACCEPTED.md.

g.inkscape:label: NAT / text label
g.title: Standard NAT Gateway: operations VM outbound access

g.text: One Azure region / three availability zones / complete lab-owned network and management scope
Microsoft Entra ID + scoped managed identities
Separate deployment, runtime, migration, test, chaos, and lifecycle identities. Authenticated, allowlisted management and identity endpoints.
Subscription Owner bootstraps Azure resources; directory permissions are verified separately.
LAB OWNERSHIP / Italy North preferred; Sweden Central fallback
No public IPs on runner VMs
VNet integrated / zoneRedundant = true / publicNetworkAccess = Disabled
Stateless ASP.NET Core API / one active revision
6-12 replicas / Dedicated D4 / at least 3 nodes
Zone-set illustration only. Replica IDs carry no asserted zone mapping.
ACR, Key Vault, Blob, Azure Monitor
Direct workload/operations peering + private DNS links.
Peering is non-transitive; endpoint traffic uses approved private routes.
Managed services reached by authenticated control paths and selected private endpoints
Workers -> private control state and checks
Private Link model / public access disabled
Additional WAL replica: Azure-managed log role.
RBAC; purge protection disabled for cleanup
All resources inside the ownership boundary, including the control plane and network, are deleted by Destroy.
Control relationships listed in control panel
Logical topology: Private Link targets are shown below the VNets; endpoint and DNS paths are aggregated for readability.
